niche: the January recalibration round of a copper smelter's SO2 monitoring network on the Atacama coast: thirteen UV-fluorescence analyzers spanned every night and adjusted at each visit against their own cylinders of SO2 in nitrogen from two suppliers, cylinders that lose SO2 as they age at a rate their interior sets (one supplier sold untreated cylinders and, from 2026, passivated ones too), the interior written only on the suppliers' certificates
answer: Send four analyzers to the January 2028 round: UVF-2207 (BL01), UVF-1964 (BL02), UVF-1987 (BL04) and UVF-2075 (BL09); the other nine stay.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who has read every rule takes each analyzer's span on the year's last night against its cylinder's certified concentration as its gain and sends none to the round (every span within 3.5 per cent, the visits' adjustments keeping them there). One who reads the cylinder changes, where the incoming cylinder reads the analyzer up to 24 per cent higher than the outgoing one, as the gas the old cylinder lost and fits the loss rate per supplier sends six, the two analyzers on passivated cylinders of the faster supplier read as 8 and 14 per cent high. The loss rate is set by the cylinder's interior (untreated about 10 per cent a year, passivated about 1), which the suppliers' certificates record and the register does not, and four analyzers go.
domain_test: General Statistics & Data Science, so the swap is of the method: the deciding quantity is each instrument's systematic measurement error, estimated from a measurement-error model in which the reference itself carries an error that grows with its age at a rate its construction sets, identified only by paired readings of two references minutes apart. Replace the model with the routine checks' own agreement with the reference (a generic summary) and none goes to the round; fit the reference's error by vendor instead of by construction and six go; the call turns on the measurement-error model itself, in a setting (gas metrology at a smelter's SO2 network) that is another field's.

driver: The decisive quantity is each unit's gain against the truth, read through routine checks against a reference whose strength falls with its age since certification at a rate its construction sets, so every adjustment of a unit to the reference writes the reference's loss into the unit and the routine checks cannot see it; the loss is measured where a unit is read on an outgoing and an incoming reference minutes apart and must be fitted by the references' construction, which one source changed partway, not by their source, before each unit's check ratio is divided by its reference's remaining strength.
driver_concrete: Each SO2 analyzer's gain on 31 December 2027 is its span reading that night over 400 ppb divided by the fraction of SO2 its cylinder still holds at its age since certification, at the loss rate the cylinder's interior sets (untreated or passivated, from the suppliers' certificates), both rates fitted on the 31 cylinder changes, where the analyzer is read on the outgoing and the incoming cylinder minutes apart.
stump: A competent solver takes the December span checks against the certified span gas as the analyzers' gains and sends none (every span within 3.5 per cent); one who reads the cylinder changes' jumps as the old gas's loss and fits the loss rate per supplier sends six, two of them on passivated cylinders of the faster supplier that have lost almost nothing; the rate is set by the cylinder's interior, which only the certificates record, and four go.

differentiation.task249: v2's units stood apart from references that shared the truth only in mixed hours (a representativeness problem); here the reference stands with the unit and loses strength with its own age, so every check agrees and the error is the reference's

notes: stump_strategy other: reference ageing, a check whose reference loses strength with its age since certification at a rate set by its construction, so the routine check cannot see the error it writes into the unit; none of the listed strategies names it (decomposition_attribution is the nearest and is banned against task475; the honest Gate G is decomposition_attribution, the analyzer's apparent agreement split into its own gain and its gas's loss). Gap objective: the span ratio is reported correctly and the decision is scored on the gain against true SO2; population: the loss rate pooled over the wrong cylinders. G13: the certified concentration holds at its certification date, not on the night of use; G6: supplier A's cylinders changed interior in 2026, so a rate per supplier is a mixture. Redrawn 2026-10-20 after task250 shipped: ban.pairing, ban.subdomain and ban.artifact (task250, physical-environmental-sciences sensor calibration, monitoring_export) and ban.shape (shape 10, task471) BLOCKed the registered card; the task is a measurement-error model's estimate (general statistics, missing data, censoring and measurement error), the stakeholder's working file is the field operations log, and the criteria come from each analyzer's verdict and each station's two 2027 record figures, a structure outside the eighteen shapes (shape 10 also wants one file).
